purpose: Current-source generation-worker qualification after the narrow Python Boolean teaching guard; no count-bound author contract.

goal.title: Exact rational arithmetic and bounded conditions
goal.learningTarget: Exact rational arithmetic and bounded conditions
goal.questionDirective: Evaluate exact expressions using addition, subtraction, multiplication and division, or solve an explicitly stated bounded integer condition. Vary the operations. Preserve the distinction between any satisfying value and an explicitly requested minimum or maximum. Use complete numerical tasks without stories or unstated physical assumptions. Aim for difficulty 2 or 3.

goal.title: Python 3 expressions
goal.questionDirective: Use complete short Python 3 expressions or correctly indented code, with explicit values. Preserve case and literal syntax. Vary the expressions and test application of Python semantics at difficulty 2 or 3. The subject is Python behavior, not arithmetic alone.

goal.title: Arithmetic and English application practice
goal.questionDirective: Cover both assigned skills with self-contained application questions at difficulty 2 or 3. Arithmetic questions use complete exact expressions or explicitly bounded integer conditions. English questions supply complete sentences in standard written American English and make the tested agreement or pronoun-reference distinction explicit.

objectives.name: Evaluate an exact rational expression or explicit bounded condition
Apply subject-verb agreement or unambiguous pronoun reference

qualification_route: Call the unmodified current-source _generate_sanitized_questions once per fixed job with its exact normalized request, real ProviderCallBudget and deadline-aware client factory. The runtime alone owns at most three author passes, top-ups, sanitization, compilation, answer-blind solving where required, immutable final auditing, and partial returns. Do not invoke SQS, DynamoDB, deployed Lambda, bank write, or API endpoint.
capture_protocol: At freeze, pin the exact executable harness, tests, 29 runtime modules, requirements, template, bounded capture helper, initial author prompt bytes and every native contract before acquiring credentials.
Create an exclusive no-resume capture with all three jobs and 18 unattempted call slots before credential acquisition. Persist each durable reservation and exact request before Converse.
Record job/pass/raw-row/source-order/compiled-spec/sanitized/verified/returned provenance; retain extra rows only as diagnostics and never replace a planned slot.

At each dispatch verify source, request, model, native schema, endpoint, us-east-1 region, three-second connect ceiling, deadline-clamped read timeout at most 200 seconds, and exactly one SDK attempt.
Bound response capture, remove reasoning and signatures, scan raw visible and decoded duplicate JSON members for credential echo before persistence, and save only safe error type/code.
Check capture digest against external modification and recheck all source and request pins after each call and at finalization. Missing response usage remains unknown.
independent_review_protocol: After capture, project all 15 original slots as opaque IDs with exact stem and rotated choices; include explicit missing placeholders. Hide arm, key, explanation, author and auditor claims.
Lock independent literal solution, four choice statuses and six pair meanings for every slot before opening private mapping, authored key, teaching or model judgments. Uncertainty fails an item.
Then inspect every authored key and all visible main/choice teaching, scope, difficulty at least two, novelty, exact compiler fields, policy revision and empty prose choice feedback.

For Python, evaluate exact values and short-circuit order and refute universal first-truthy/first-falsy claims with absent-trigger final-operand examples. For English, preserve American notional plural alternatives where the stem lacks unit/member disambiguation.
failure_policy: Ordinary provider, timeout, safety, malformed, model-review and deadline failures consume their reserved call and original slots; later independent jobs remain eligible. Global credential/SDK setup, source/request/contract/provenance/capture integrity, unsafe output or budget overrun stops all work. No retry, rescue, warmup, cache flush, replacement job, count-bound switch, or second run.
offline_prerequisites: Use the pinned Python 3.12.11 interpreter and dependency search path recorded in offline_validation_environment; do not use the system default Python 3.9.
Port the previously pinned mixed_probe.py to this current source as a separate harness; remove historical source-delta assumptions and include all 29 current runtime modules in exact pins.
Run offline guard, native schema, budget/deadline, source drift, credential-echo, provenance and late-response tests on that harness.
Review the final generated plan and harness hashes, then make an explicit frozen copy before any provider dispatch.

estimated_calls.planning_estimate: 9–18 Converse attempts; approximately 13 if behavior resembles the previous longer-read run. Zero authorized in this preparation.

claim_limits: Fresh batches on reused assignments are descriptive, not a same-item causal comparison or broad accuracy estimate. A passing generation route does not qualify SQS, DynamoDB, deployed Lambda, bank inventory, default settings or release. The count-bound author trial remains separate.
